rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person walking with an injured or weak leg.

example.english: My leg is injured, so I limp home.
example.traditional: 我隻腳受咗傷，跛住行返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 sau6 zo2 soeng1 bo2 zyu6 haang4 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this for a vehicle or machine that can still travel despite a malfunction.

example.english: The car has a flat tire and can only limp back to the garage.
example.traditional: 架車爆咗胎，只可以勉強行返車房。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 baau3 zo2 toi1 zi2 ho2 ji5 min5 koeng5 haang4 faan1 ce1 fong2

rows.note: Use this when a process, piece of writing, or other activity proceeds awkwardly or irregularly.

example.english: The application process is proceeding in a limp, awkward way and will take ages.
example.traditional: 今次個申請流程行得唔順，要搞好耐。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 san1 cing2 lau4 cing4 haang4 dak1 m4 seon6 jiu3 gaau2 hou2 noi6
